links.kind: All 16 accepted D3 seeds from the fixed n50/n51 subpanel; original 50-input frontier remains unchanged.

question: Can the bounded-export checkpoint producer lift all 16 independently accepted retained D3 seeds to independently checked D4 certificates under a 27 GiB child cap?

claims.text: For each named presentation, an independently checked D4 certificate whose codimension exceeds a fresh exhaustive solution count certifies LFD at least 5.

arms.description: All 16 accepted D3 seeds from the terminal original n50/n51 panel, in fixed original order: recheck each seed, recount solutions, run the bounded-export checkpoint D4 candidate, then independently check any D4 certificate.
Fresh exhaustive Boolean solution count for each same named input using pinned count_by_sum; the retained prior counts are cross-checks.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic certificate checks and exhaustive counts; no runtime comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Native checkpoint candidate passed 150 retained and generated fixture controls, including degree-three seeds; each frontier seed and output is independently checked in this run. The new orchestration driver is syntax checked, with prior cascade records retained as references.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Rejected or missing checker acceptance, count mismatch, producer refusal and killed constant are explicit non-success statuses. No upper-bound inference from them.

factors.name: input
factors.how: All 16 D3-accepted seeds from the terminal n50/n51 original frontier subpanel, selected by an independently checked D3 gate. No seed excluded by D4 outcome or profile; the original 50-input plan remains unchanged.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Bounded-export checkpoint native binary, new retained-seed driver, checker and counter hashes pinned; native D3-to-D4 fixture qualification and source-derived envelopes retained.

factors.name: host
factors.how: One shared local host, sequential 27 GiB-capped native workers, one thread, exclusive campaign locks and MemAvailable >=29 GiB at launch. No timing claim.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Original plan order of the 16 accepted D3 seeds; per input seed hash/checker, fresh exact count, D4 producer and checker. Each named input attempted once.

factors.name: stage
factors.how: D3 seed verification and exact count precede D4 candidate. D4 acceptance is conditional on native output and independent checker; resource refusals retain their D3 bound.

comparisons.threshold: Original checker accepts degree 4 and fresh exhaustive count is strictly below checked codimension.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact certificates and enumeration; no timing comparison.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

seed_derivation.note: No new random input; reuse exact original records and retained accepted D3 certificate hashes.

instance_sampling.rule: All 16 accepted D3 seeds from the completed n50/n51 original frontier subpanel, before any bounded D4 outcome. Named-input inference only; no population or timing inference.

blinding.how: Exact inputs and prior campaign are visible; no population or timing inference.

power.note: Sixteen fixed exact named inputs; no population inference or statistical power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Per-item native watchdog times 16 is an allowance, not a prediction.

primary.name: accepted D4 codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq only after the original independent checker accepts the degree-four certificate; absent otherwise.
primary.source: per-item result.json stages entry at degree 4, certified_codimension

secondary.name: exhaustive Boolean solution count
secondary.definition: Fresh count from the pinned native counter; no copied historical value is a new measurement.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Each item retains stage records after completion; the native D4 candidate runs without application checkpoints. Interrupted items remain incomplete and are not automatically retried.

stopping_rules.rule: Attempt all 16 retained seeds once in original order. For each, stop on resource refusal, timeout, count mismatch, checker failure or projection_kills_one; retain the accepted D3 bound and any accepted D4 result. No automatic retry.
Resource refusal, timeout, invalid certificate or counter failure is retained without an LFD inference.

Launch only after the n50/n51 D3 panel is terminal, the 16 seed assets have been published and read back, exclusive campaign locks are acquired, MemAvailable >=29 GiB, all pinned bytes match, and the output root is absent. No concurrent frontier producer.

invalidation_rules: Any seed, source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure or mismatch prevents solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing D4 remains unknown; an accepted D3 stage retains only its own lower bound.

decision_rule.text: At an accepted degree-four stage, exact_count < checked_codimension establishes named-input LFD>=5; this run does not attempt degree five.
decision_rule.threshold: Independent D4 acceptance and exact_count < checked_codimension

inputs: 16 retained accepted D3 seed certificates and prior results
outputs: Per-item retained-seed checks, fresh counts, D4 candidate and original checker transcripts; conditional LFD>=5 named-input bounds.

graphs: Per-instance D4 outcomes with unknown cells explicit; no runtime graph

inadmissible: Calling a native candidate certified before the original checker accepts it.
Inferring LFD>=6 from a D4 certificate.
Treating a resource refusal, timeout or killed constant as an upper bound.
Replacing the original 50-input frontier plan or imputing unrun D5 cells.

literature.claim: Constructive quotient-lift rationale, source review and remaining validation requirements.
